SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  100 - (irate_right(summary) / $cpu_count * 100.0) AS cpu_usage_percent
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, time) AS bucket,
      counter_agg(time, value) AS summary
    FROM
      pganalyze.sys_stats
    WHERE
      metric = 'node_cpu_seconds_total'
      AND labels ->> 'mode' = 'idle'
      AND $__timeFilter(time) 
    GROUP BY
      bucket
  ) t

SELECT
    time,
    (
        (
            MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_MemTotal_bytes')
            - MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_MemFree_bytes')
            - MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_Buffers_bytes')
            - MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_Cached_bytes')
            - MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes')
        )
        / NULLIF(
            MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_MemTotal_bytes'),
            0
        )
    ) * 100 AS memory_usage_percent
FROM pganalyze.sys_stats
WHERE
    metric LIKE 'node_memory%'
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
    time,
    value AS db_size_bytes
FROM pganalyze.sys_stats
WHERE
    metric = 'postgres_data_size_bytes'
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

WITH memory AS (
    SELECT value AS memory_bytes
    FROM pganalyze.sys_stats
    WHERE metric = 'node_memory_MemTotal_bytes'
    ORDER BY time DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    i.hostname,
    i.os_name AS "OS",
    i.kernel_name || ' ' || i.kernel_version AS "kernel",
    i.cpu_count AS "CPUs",
    m.memory_bytes AS "RAM"
FROM pganalyze.sys_info AS i
CROSS JOIN memory AS m

SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  "mode",
  (irate_right(summary) / $cpu_count * 100.0) AS cpu_usage_percent
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, time) AS bucket,
      labels ->> 'mode' AS "mode",
      counter_agg(time, value) AS summary
    FROM
      pganalyze.sys_stats
    WHERE
      metric = 'node_cpu_seconds_total'
      AND labels ->> 'mode' != 'idle'
      AND $__timeFilter(time) 
    GROUP BY
      bucket, "mode"
  ) t
  ORDER BY time

SELECT
    time_bucket('$agg_interval', time) as time,
        (
            MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_MemTotal_bytes')
            - MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_MemFree_bytes')
            - MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_Buffers_bytes')
            - MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_Cached_bytes')
            - MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes')
        ) AS Application,
    (MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_Cached_bytes') + MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes')) AS Cached,
    MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_Buffers_bytes') AS Buffers,
    MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_MemFree_bytes') AS Free,
    MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_memory_MemTotal_bytes') AS Total
FROM pganalyze.sys_stats
WHERE
    metric LIKE 'node_memory%'
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, time) AS time,
  (MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_filesystem_size_bytes') - MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_filesystem_avail_bytes')) / MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'node_filesystem_size_bytes') * 100 AS mountpoint,
  labels ->> 'mountpoint' AS label
FROM
  pganalyze.sys_stats
WHERE
  metric LIKE 'node_filesystem%'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY
  time,
  label
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, time) AS time,
  AVG(value) / $cpu_count,
  metric
FROM
  pganalyze.sys_stats
WHERE
  metric LIKE 'node_load%'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY
  time,
  metric
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  device || ' ' || CASE
        WHEN metric = 'node_disk_reads_completed_total' THEN 'reads'
        WHEN metric = 'node_disk_writes_completed_total' THEN 'writes'
      END AS metric,
  irate_right(summary) AS value
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, time) AS bucket,
      labels ->> 'device' AS device,
      metric,
      counter_agg(time, value) AS summary
    FROM
      pganalyze.sys_stats
    WHERE
      metric LIKE 'node_disk_%_completed_total'
      AND $__timeFilter(time)
    GROUP BY
      bucket,
      metric,
      device
  ) t
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  device || ' ' || CASE
        WHEN metric = 'node_disk_read_bytes_total' THEN 'read'
        WHEN metric = 'node_disk_written_bytes_total' THEN 'write'
      END AS metric,
  irate_right(summary) AS value
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, time) AS bucket,
      labels ->> 'device' AS device,
      metric,
      counter_agg(time, value) AS summary
    FROM
      pganalyze.sys_stats
    WHERE
      metric LIKE 'node_disk_%_bytes_total'
      AND $__timeFilter(time)
    GROUP BY
      bucket,
      metric,
      device
  ) t
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  device,
  irate_right(summary) * 100 AS percent -- sec/sec
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, time) AS bucket,
      labels ->> 'device' AS device,
      counter_agg(time, value) AS summary
    FROM
      pganalyze.sys_stats
    WHERE
      metric = 'node_disk_io_time_seconds_total'
      AND $__timeFilter(time)
    GROUP BY
      bucket,
      device
  ) t
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    device,
    (
        irate_right(write_time_summary)
        / NULLIF(irate_right(write_completed_summary), 0)
    ) AS write,
    (
        irate_right(read_time_summary)
        / NULLIF(irate_right(read_completed_summary), 0)
    ) AS read
FROM (
    SELECT
        time_bucket('$agg_interval'::INTERVAL, time) AS bucket,
        labels ->> 'device' AS device,
        counter_agg(time, value) FILTER (
            WHERE metric = 'node_disk_write_time_seconds_total'
        ) AS write_time_summary,
        counter_agg(time, value) FILTER (
            WHERE metric = 'node_disk_writes_completed_total'
        ) AS write_completed_summary,
        counter_agg(time, value) FILTER (
            WHERE metric = 'node_disk_read_time_seconds_total'
        ) AS read_time_summary,
        counter_agg(time, value) FILTER (
            WHERE metric = 'node_disk_reads_completed_total'
        ) AS read_completed_summary
    FROM pganalyze.sys_stats
    WHERE
        metric IN (
            'node_disk_write_time_seconds_total',
            'node_disk_writes_completed_total',
            'node_disk_read_time_seconds_total',
            'node_disk_reads_completed_total'
        )
        AND $__timeFilter(time)
    GROUP BY
        bucket,
        device
) t
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  container,
  irate_right(summary) * 100 AS value
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, time) AS bucket,
      labels ->> 'container' AS container,
      counter_agg(time, value) AS summary
    FROM
      pganalyze.sys_stats
    WHERE
      metric = 'container_cpu_usage_seconds_total'
      AND $__timeFilter(time)
    GROUP BY
      bucket,
      container
  ) t
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, time) AS time,
  metric,
  AVG(value) AS value
FROM
  pganalyze.sys_stats
WHERE
  metric LIKE 'postgres_%_bytes'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY
  time,
  metric
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  container,
  irate_right(summary) * 100 AS value
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, time) AS bucket,
      labels ->> 'container' AS container,
      counter_agg(time, value) AS summary
    FROM
      pganalyze.sys_stats
    WHERE
      metric = 'container_cpu_usage_seconds_total'
      AND $__timeFilter(time)
    GROUP BY
      bucket,
      container
  ) t
ORDER BY
  time
